dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 21, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**PITCHERS DOMINATE ON THE MOUND AS MLB SEEKS ITS STRIDE**

The Cleveland Guardians edged out the Detroit Tigers 3-1 behind Joey Cantillo's dominant start, as he tossed 5.2 scoreless innings with 6 strikeouts. Meanwhile, Braxton Ashcraft led the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 6-2 win over the St. Louis Cardinals with 7 strong innings, fanning 9 Cardinals. Cade Cavalli, however, took the loss for the Washington Nationals despite a 7-inning performance with 9 strikeouts against the New York Mets. In the Atlanta Braves' 9-3 triumph over the Miami Marlins, Spencer Strider earned the win with 6.1 innings of work and 9 strikeouts. Luis Severino also shined in the Athletics' 3-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, striking out 10 over 7 innings.

On the hitting front, Dillon Dingler's 9th home run of the season led the Guardians, while Brandon Lowe and Michael Harris II each homered twice for the Pirates and Braves, respectively. George Springer also connected for his 4th home run of the season in the Toronto Blue Jays' 2-0 win over the New York Yankees.
